title: Finite source coordinate through the single comparison
statement: For e:X≅P¹_S, a level n and section-normalized coefficient coordinates c on X, the normalized source coordinate finiteOverUnitCoordinate of [lem-sfb-finite-p1-coefficient-adjunction-coordinates] is the single comparison of evaluation followed by the finite source coordinate finiteKummerUnitCoordinate of [def-sfb-finite-p1-kummer-coordinates].

source.place: paragraph (1), normalized finite positive Kummer class before direct image

proof.text: Unfold both coordinates: each is the single comparison, the inverse single complex of c.unit, the inverse of nuSingle and the inverse ordinary unit pullback along e; they agree up to reassociation.

theorem finiteP1_unit_coordinate_eq (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S)
    (n : ℕ) {hX : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤))}
    (c : SpTowerP1.CoefficientCoordinates l E n X hX) :
    (finiteOverUnitCoordinate l E n e c).hom =
      ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
        (finiteKummerUnitCoordinate l E n e c).hom
